## 1.3.29 (HexGhoul): people come up to you with something to say (520+ scenes, the Answer key); a spouse keeps house at home; "Go home, please."; quests only from whoever gives them, a Romance tab; Touka her own way, one small wing (testing)
HexKagune 1.3.29 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 65**: client and server must both be 1.3.29). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, not tried in game.

- **They come up to you (new).** Your partner (every few minutes), friends (less often), your children and the ghouls who walk with you walk up with something on their mind: a card pops up with what they said. Press **O (the Answer key, rebindable)** or right-click them and the talk opens on it. Ignore them and they notice: a clingy partner thinks a little less of you, a child is sad for a while. Never during a fight (10 s after anyone was hurt) and never while another talk is open.
  - Over 520 scenes (about 4,600 lines) for Eto, Touka, Ken, the children and ghoul allies, each with answers that lead somewhere. Which ones you get depends on how close you are, their mood, day or night, a child's age and temperament, an ally's temper. Their scripted topics also turn up in the companions' "Talk a while" page, the children's "Talk" and the allies' "Let's talk."
  - **Children have a temperament now** (shy, bold, gentle...), the same one for life, leaning towards the companion parent's, plus a mood that comes and goes.
- **A spouse keeps house (new).** At a home you declared ("This is our home now."), by day, your spouse no longer just walks to the door and straight back. They do chores:
  - **Puts a chest in order.** Walks to a chest or barrel, the lid goes up (vanilla chests), bends over it, and when done its things really are **sorted by name and stacked together**. Nothing is ever lost or duplicated (the tests check this thousands of times). Trapped chests only look tidied (redstone builds use them) and ender chests are never touched.
  - **Sweeps the floor** with the brush, dust coming up. **Things lying on the floor** (for 10 s or more, never in water, so item streams are left alone) **get swept up and put into a chest**, then they walk over to that chest and tidy it.
  - **Wipes the tables** (crafting table, any table), leaving a clean sparkle.
  - **Goes outside round the house with a bucket and waters the flowers, crops and saplings**, with splashes. A watered crop or sapling may grow a step. No watering when it's raining.
  - Also takes a book off a shelf or lectern for a while and looks out of the windows.
  - Each chore is a short round of a few chests, plants or tables, nearest first, every half minute to a minute alone at home (every one to two minutes with you about). Their own lines when they start and finish (Eto teasing, Touka grumbling, Ken gentle), now and then, to you only.
  - Anything else comes first: a fight, a talk, a kiss, your hand, a child, bedtime. The chore stops where it is and the chest lid shuts.
- **Better walking at home.** If they make no progress for 3 s they set off again. If they're hopelessly stuck they're put next to what they were going to (or back on the home's spot), never while you're standing right next to them. A spot they can't reach at all is given up. Their wandering pauses while a chore is going.
- **"Go home, please." (new talk option).** On a companion's first page, next to "Follow me." / "Wait here.", whenever they're away from home (following you, or waiting where you left them). A spouse goes back to the home you share, anyone else to their own place (Eto's Library, Anteiku, Ken's tower). They walk if it's near; from far off they're simply there once the talk is over.
- **Quests: only from whoever gives them.** No quest pops up by itself any more unless your path needs it:
  - **Your path's quests** (the ones that open your transformations) still open with mastery, as before.
  - **A teacher's quests come only from the teacher.** "Light on Your Feet", "Up We Go!", "Witness This" and "One Eye" are **Eto's lessons**: they appear when you ask her "Teach me something.", and the journal says so. The old copies that opened on their own are retired (if you'd already started one, it keeps going). The quests whose gates Touka and Ken teach now (Crystal Rain, The Black Rabbit, 1000 Minus 7, The One-Eyed King...) become **their practice**, given once they've taught you that lesson.
  - **The ghouls of the night's quests** (Among Our Own, A Friend in the Dark, Cold Blood, Errands, Side by Side) appear once you've talked to a ghoul.
  - **Feats.** First Meal, Night Stalker, The Brink, Rampage, Die Hard, Cannibal and Ghoul Eater are never handed out or listed. They count by themselves and show up (and pay) as a **Feat** once you've done them.
  - **Hunts come only when you ask.** No more hunts appearing at dusk. At night, ask any ghoul you can talk to **"Any prey out tonight?"** and they'll give you tonight's hunt (one a night, until dawn).
  - **"You already know this."** Ask a teacher (Eto, Touka, Ken) for a lesson you already have some other way (a command, an old quest) and they say so ("You already know Gatling. Don't waste my time. ...Fine. Next."), then move on: they teach the next one, or tell you what it needs. Touka and Ken always offer "Teach me" now, so that question always gets an answer.
- **Romance tab in the quest journal (new).** Each companion: met or not (and where to find them), the stage (friends, with someone else, errands, dating, your wife or husband), regard with a bar, the errands and how far along, days together, the home, children (and one on the way), and **what to do next** ("Regard 72 of 90 to propose...", "Ready: offer her a ring", "Stand where you want to live and tell her...").
- **Touka her own way.** She kisses with one hand at your head, cheek or neck (it changes each time) and never wraps her arms round you. She pecks your cheek, crosses her arms flustered afterwards, hugs stiffly. Asked to hold her, she gives you a hug instead. Unasked she gives a peck on the cheek, or now and then a **stolen kiss**: your view is turned to her, she kisses you before you know it, then complains about it. Friends and partners can learn about her past with Ken (she ended it; he never wanted to be touched), never once you're married to her.
- **Touka's kagune: one small wing** on her right; every spike comes from it.

Untested in game: the approach cards and the Answer key, every scene, the chores (chest sorting, sweeping things into a chest, watering, the lid), the unstuck walking, "Go home, please.", the new quest rules and hunts on request, "you already know this", the Romance tab (rendered offscreen only), Touka's poses and stolen kiss (the view turn), the single wing. All of it is compiled and unit tested only.
